concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-003 (feature attribution scores must be measured against independent physical measurements or properties not encoded as features) is not explicitly addressed in the plan. The plan describes Integrated Gradients and a sensitivity analysis, but does not state a comparison to external physical measurements.
Success Criterion SC-004 (execution time must be measured against the 6‑hour limit) is only estimated in the plan ("estimated ≤ 5 h") and lacks a concrete measurement step or logging requirement.
Success Criterion SC-5 (memory usage must be measured against the 7 GB RAM limit) is similarly only estimated ("peak RAM < 1 GB") without an explicit measurement or validation step.
